name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc20): error messages actually reach you now. Every failure used to arrive as the same sentence, 'Error executing tool <name>', with no status code and no detail - so a typo, a 404 and a permission refusal looked identical and the fix was never in what you saw. The real text now comes through, including the one that names the remedy ('Set allow_write: true in its connections.json profile'). Also: a write that succeeded is no longer reported as rejected when the screen takes a code and the table stores an ID, and dry_run now works on a read-only profile. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
